basics.name: Behzat Bilgin Erdem
basics.label: Software Engineer - frontend-heavy web and mobile, 5+ years
basics.summary: Frontend-heavy software engineer with 5+ years building web and mobile products in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and React Native. Recent work spans dashboards and secure authentication flows, a FastAPI-backed product, Web3 interfaces, and containerized full-stack apps with GraphQL and Docker. Works across the stack with Node.js, Django, Strapi, and PostgreSQL, deploys on AWS, Azure, and Vercel, and is grounded in a physics and scientific-computing background.
